solutions.title: Iterative dummy head
solutions.notes: Iterative dummy head — O(1) extra stack
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Dummy node; always attach the smaller of `list1`/`list2`; append leftovers.

**Why preferred:** No recursion depth risk on long lists; easy to narrate in interviews.

solutions.title: Recursive merge
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Base cases for null lists; pick the smaller head and recurse for `next`.

**vs recommended:** Clean and correct. Prefer iterative dummy-head when lists can be long or the interviewer cares about stack space.
